intro.lead: Guraben aiki da ke buɗe a shirye-shiryen buɗaɗɗen tushe na nahiyar. Babu CV ko wasiƙa: kowane gurbi yana da aikin «matakin farko», kuma lambarka ce ke gabatar da kai ga ƙungiyar.
intro.signIn: Shiga don ganin yadda ka dace da kowane matsayi

filters.unavailable: Babu gurbin aiki tare da sauran matatun

results.moreError: Sauran guraben aikin ba su iya lodawa ba.
results.emptyText: Ƙungiyoyi suna wallafa matsayin da suke nema a nan. Ƙaddamar da shirinka ka faɗi wanda kake nema: naka zai zama na farko.
results.errorTitle: Guraben aikin ba su iya lodawa ba
results.errorText: Duba haɗin intanet ɗinka, sannan ka sake gwadawa.
results.noMatchTitle: Babu gurbin aiki da ya dace a yanzu
results.noMatchText: Cire matata ko gwada wata kalma. Ƙungiyoyi suna wallafa sababbin matsayi kowane mako.
results.publishText: Wallafa matsayin da aikinsa na «matakin farko»: masu haɓaka manhaja na nahiyar za su same shi a nan.
results.filled: An cike wannan matsayi yanzu: ba ya karɓar nema kuma.

form.projectText: Ƙungiyar da kake ɗaukar ma'aikata mata.
form.roleText: Sana'ar da kake nema: da ita ake tace tallace-tallace.
form.detailsText: Abin da mutumin zai yi, da inda zai iya farawa.
form.projectRequired: Zaɓi aikin da ke ɗaukar ma'aikata.
form.noProjectText: Ana wallafa gurbi da sunan aikin da kake jagoranta ko kake kula da shi.
form.loadFailed: Ba a iya loda ayyukanka ba.
form.previewHint: Tallan kamar yadda zai bayyana a shafin tallace-tallace.
form.previewEmpty: Zaɓi aiki da gurbi: tallan zai fara bayyana a nan.
form.discardText: Tallan da kake rubutawa zai ɓace daga wannan na'ura.
